summary: FAIL. F-DG0-115 (High, mandatory) remains OPEN. tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs is unchanged since round 5, and the back-dated side-branch merge still replaces committed reviewer evidence undetected: a FAIL verification of a High finding becomes CLOSED_VERIFIED, and a round-1 High finding and FAIL verdict are dropped, while the current, historical and pipeline validations all pass. The new round-6 code (run_meta.py, the runner metadata fix, the CI step) works as intended. But it ships two committed __pycache__/*.pyc files, which the candidate's own tests rewrite on any clean checkout. prefreeze.sh then fails, --freeze refuses and the working-tree candidate ID drifts (F-DG0-130, Medium). prefreeze.sh's dirty check also misses candidate files under docs/delivery and untracked files (F-DG0-131, Low, acceptable as an observation). Of my 21 earlier findings, 20 are re-verified CLOSED_VERIFIED, each reproduced on its old commit and shown fixed on a059b55. F-DG0-115 is FAIL/OPEN.
